name: calcom-booking-created-to-travel-blocks

deploy.description: Cal.com booking created for the in-person event type (slug in-person) -> two private, busy 45-minute travel blocks on dennis@work.flowers, before and after the meeting. Cal.com's own buffers only block Cal.com slots; these make travel visible on Google Calendar. Blocks carry 'cal-booking-uid: <uid>' in the description so the cancelled/rescheduled siblings can find them.

trigger.authentication_note: Cal.com connection 'dennis-work' (dchiuten@work.flowers, Cal.com user dennis-chiuten, verified via GET /v2/me 2026-10-20). NOT the stale 'dennis-chiuten' connection 02d05cb6-4d5d-81b0-954c-ce3bbb24eabc, whose token refresh fails with invalid_grant.
trigger.trigger_note: REST-hook trigger, no input fields (verified via list-trigger-input-fields 2026-10-20), so the event-type filter lives in code on payload.eventType.slug. Payload shape captured from a real booking through a trigger inbox on 2026-10-20 — see README.

connections_note: gcal_wf is the work.flowers Google Calendar connection ('Google Calendar dennis@work.flowers') — where the travel blocks live.
